---
title: "AI and the Ladder of Development"
author: "Tim Dobermann"
categories: [AI, growth]
description: >
  A small open economy model of AI, structural transformation, and
  development.
---

**Abstract.** Develops a small open economy model of AI, structural transformation, and development. Decomposes AI's effect on capability growth to demonstrate a potential development trap: AI can raise average tradable productivity yet reduce long-run capability growth if a wage-driven Baumol reallocation effect pushes labour toward weak-learning local services.
